For the D Shawl Lapel, 11 cm wide shown in the image, the geometry differs from a standard shawl lapel because the lower section forms a distinct teardrop ("D") profile with a pointed sweep at the bottom. This style is common in high-fashion tuxedos, double-breasted dinner jackets, and certain bespoke Italian patterns.
